articles.title: How to book a guest and make the hotel bill
articles.summary: Add your rooms, book a guest, print the registration card, check out and make the GST bill on the free Nivesh Sahayak hotel maker.
faq: Does the bill count in my accounts?
Yes. A stay printed as a bill is a sale in NSBiz. A booking card and a cancelled stay are not.

articles.title: How to use the room diary and the Today list
articles.summary: How to read the room diary, the Today list of arrivals and departures, and the warning for a room booked twice, in the Nivesh Sahayak hotel maker.
faq: Why is a room shown as "not in list"?
A stay uses a room number you have not added under Rooms. Add the room, or ignore the label.
